clips.name: grow_divide
clips.label: grow and divide, no chemistry
clips.caption: 2,000 → 25,079 cells. Growth and division (structural) beside mechanics (lateral) and edge flips (rewire). A sphere that stays a sphere.

clips.name: r021_12
clips.label: the Turing activities added
clips.caption: Diffusion and reaction now run on the cell graph that division keeps rewiring. Stripes ride a growing shell.

clips.name: r005_06
clips.label: chemistry gates growth
clips.caption: One exchange ties the reaction to curvature, and the activator gates cell_grow. Arms where the activator sits.

clips.name: r013_05
clips.label: an interface tension added
clips.caption: One more lateral, interface_tension, at the activator sites. 12,201 cells; eight arms.

clips.name: r016_01
clips.label: one constant halved
clips.caption: The kill rate kk: 0.062 → 0.031, and the reaction rate with it. Lobes and branches instead of arms.

clips.name: r017_00_ctrl
clips.label: the tension removed
clips.caption: Same chemistry, interface_tension deleted from the schedule. Growth alone: the longest arms.

clips.name: r020_01
clips.label: reaction faster than growth
clips.caption: The reaction rate rate: 0.25 → 0.75. The shell folds instead of arming.

clips.name: r021_06
clips.label: growth faster than reaction
clips.caption: cell_grow rate doubled, reaction at 0.25. Five long thin arms.

clips.name: tsd_max
clips.label: a second chemistry drives death
clips.caption: Four chemical states: species A gates growth, species B gates cell_die. Growth and death land in different places.

clips.name: sc_antiphase
clips.label: one chemistry drives both
clips.caption: The same activator gates growth where it is high and death where it is low. Death can only fall between the spots.
